say: Three watchers, all posted SOUTH; the far waypoints run NORTH at z~6. Openings first: walk the party to the first scarpet hold on the north side and watch the amber walks before committing to a route.
Hold on the scarpet. Sample the patrols: where do the sentries turn, and does any walk reach the north lane?
Second sample beat for patrol amplitude.
sentry_0 was heading north at last look; one more beat so it turns and walks AWAY before we break cover. Never dash into an approaching walk.

Break: sprint the party deep north-east to the gallery landing (26.25, 11.25) — north of sentry_1's observed reach (z~5-7). Run ON: exposure time beats stamina here; the walks cross the lane we're leaving.
(run toggles for the other two as well)
The dash itself.
Walk again — stamina is a closed bar and room 3 still needs a crossing.
Observe from the landing: where is sentry_2's walk, and did anyone get spotted on the dash?

MISTAKE LOGGED: I extrapolated sentry_1's reach from two samples; its walk + detect + pursuit reached the landing. Spotted x2, struck. LESSON: observe a FULL loop before crossing a room, or buy the window instead of guessing.
It's in recover — the disengage window. Break EAST to the Capbage full-hide before it re-acquires. Aster and Peris run; Endo (stamina 37) walks — a burned bar is a corpse in room 3.
Everyone into the leaf. Walk mode again.
Hold hidden: let the chase shed and the walks go home.
LESSON LOGGED: only Aster reads FULL conceal — the Capbage is a ONE-BODY hide and my slot spread parked the others outside the leaf. A party needs one leaf each, or staggered turns.

sentry_2 sits at its far WEST post — the widest window room 3 will offer. The exit shelter is sanctuary: run everyone the 11wu south NOW; at 25hp Aster survives nothing, so exposure time is the only currency that matters.
The sprint to sanctuary.
Bed down — the win runs through the shelter rest.
LESSON RE-LEARNED (Skumnut already paid for this one): a mid-stride body cannot bed down. Settle a beat, then rest.
Rest, properly settled this time.

LESSON LOGGED: the rest must be committed by a SELECTED character — this is Peris's fragment and only she is in the active party. My aster pokes were the wrong-actor mistake Dean makes on purpose. Bed down as Peris.
Second half of the same lesson: the ACTOR must stand AT the pad (a real click walks you there before firing). Peris steps onto the pad.
Settle, then rest.
Bed down.
